title: Godrej Consumer Products Ltd - 532424 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: GCPL Q1 FY27: consolidated revenue up 19% YoY on 9% underlying volume growth, EBITDA up 14% with 19% margin; India gross margin hit by war-linked input costs.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 19% YoY with underlying volume growth of 9%, EBITDA rose 14% at a 19% margin, and net profit grew 11%. India gross margin fell sharply as LPG, kerosene and LABSA roughly trebled during the war-driven spike, with India cost impact near 6% over plan. Africa (GAUM) delivered an exceptional quarter with constant-currency growth around 25% and EBITDA margins moving to mid-teens, while Indonesia returned to stable growth at about 10%. Management says it is on track for full-year guidance and expects to exceed it on revenue, and possibly on EBITDA and volume.

segments.name: India Household Insecticides (HI)
segments.commentary: Management says GCPL gained overall HI market share in Q1 FY27 for the first time in almost a decade, driven by incense sticks, not premium segments. June was very weak due to rain and poor fill rates; July first half also poor.

segments.name: India Air care / Speedboats
segments.commentary: Speedboats grew about 3% in Q1 per analyst calculation; salience about 15% and management expects roughly 100-150 bps rise per quarter. Air care in India hit by LPG-linked fill rate falls of 20-25%.

segments.name: Africa / GAUM
segments.commentary: Constant-currency growth about 25%, driven by FMCG (air care at double-digit market share in South Africa within six months of launch) and hair extensions cost improvements. FY26 growth split was about 50:50 FMCG and hair.

segments.name: Indonesia
segments.commentary: Growth about 10% on a slower base, step-up in air media, and early El Nino benefit; Stellar business growing faster.

segments.name: Soaps (India)
segments.commentary: Volumes grew positively in Q1; management expects early single-digit growth in Q2 and Q3, soap margins at normative levels.

segments.name: Muuchstac (acquired DTC brand)
segments.commentary: Growth of about 70-80% from acquisition run rate; EPS accretive from day one, profitable digital-first brand.

segments.name: Pet care
segments.commentary: Committed INR500 crore capital; additional INR200 crore rights commitment referenced by analyst. Product-market fit achieved in Tamil Nadu; expansion to rest of South India under way.

guidance_outlook: Remains on track for full-year guidance, with confidence to exceed it in select areas.
Revenue growth expected to exceed guidance significantly.
EBITDA: double-digit growth guidance may be exceeded slightly, depending on commodities.
Volume growth expected in and around or slightly above guidance; cash flow may be squeezed.
India: stand-alone EBITDA double digit, or high single digit if commodities worsen; India volume about 100 bps higher each year, around 8% for the year per management.
India EBITDA margin target 22-26% for the year, with return to normative margins by H2 FY27; Q2 still affected by consumption replacement, with Q3 seen as normalised.
Africa mid-to-high teens constant-currency growth seen sustainable for rest of FY27; currency tailwind expected to last another 4-5 months.
Management expects to be a few quarters away from consistent double-digit underlying volume growth.
capex_capacity: Liquid dishwash entry Godrej Rizz launched in select states; category size INR2,500-3,000 crore growing strong double digits.
Spic brand expanded pan-India after test market.
Pet care: INR500 crore capital commitment; expanding from Tamil Nadu into rest of South India.
Media spend cut 7-8% but management plans to raise media when input costs cool to fund new categories.
demand_pricing: India weighted average pricing about 5% taken in Q1; management may take a little more but is cautious as crude has cooled.
Input costs: LPG rose to INR190/kg at war peak from INR60 before war, now about INR90/kg; kerosene and LABSA also roughly trebled; Brent about $84-90.
Management said India cost impact about 6% over plan (about 9-10% total cost increase over planning, with 6% unforeseen).
Liquid dishwash growing strong double digits as consumers shift from bars to liquids; Godrej Protect previously tried this category.
Hair colour: INR15 crem growing strongly and now the widest-distributed hair colour pack by volume, bigger than market leader Henna.
Management expects palm oil and crude volatility plus El Nino effects through the year.

qa_highlights.question: Speedboat contribution target of 20% looks behind with only about 3% growth in Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says it is broadly on plan; air fill rates in India fell and salience rises about 100-150 bps per quarter, so full-year targets may be exceeded.

qa_highlights.question: Outlook for India volume and pricing trajectory?
qa_highlights.answer: Q1 India volume 7% is at the lower end; India volume expected to rise about 100 bps a year. Pricing about 5% taken with more possible, but caution as costs fell.

qa_highlights.question: Why did India gross margin fall so sharply and how fast will it recover?
qa_highlights.answer: LPG, kerosene and LABSA trebled, with GCPL among the largest LPG and kerosene users in FMCG. Management expects return to normative margins in H2 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Is media spend being cut and will it be restored?
qa_highlights.answer: Media spend down about 7-8%, media reach down about 3%; share of voice maintained in core and will be raised as costs ease for new launches.

qa_highlights.question: How long will the Africa currency tailwind last?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO Aasif Malbari said the tailwind should last another 4 to 5 months and reduce toward the end of H2.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the sharp Indonesia turnaround?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited a slower base, stepped-up air media, El Nino benefit and faster growth in the Stellar business.

risks_watch: Crude and palm oil volatility; Brent at $84-90 and costs yo-yoing make pricing decisions difficult.
Weak HI season in Q2 due to poor monsoon/fill rates; El Nino may hurt India HI in H1 but help in H2 and Indonesia.
Possible palm crop impact from El Nino, not yet seen.
Africa volume growth beyond FY27 may not sustain 17% levels; currency tailwind fades in late H2.
Q2 margin still affected by inventory replacement; India margin recovery depends on pricing taken after crude stabilises.
Competitive response to Rizz and Spic launches in liquid dishwash and detergents.
summary.management_tone: Confident on overall delivery and guidance, with clear acknowledgement of volatility; cautious and evasive on near-term India pricing and margin timing, saying crude is too volatile to give a precise pricing view. Management declined to share market share numbers for new launches.
key_quotes: We remain firmly on track to deliver our guidance for the full year with the confidence to exceed the same in select areas.
After almost a decade, we gained overall market share in the household insecticide category in Q1 FY27.
In the next couple of quarters, we should get back to normative margin in India.
